questions.stem: Why does this page say some frameworks, such as certain ORM tools, may not work well with records?

options.text: They offer no constructor that takes no arguments
options.says: Limitations 4 and 6: records provide no default no-argument constructor, which some frameworks rely on.

options.text: They allow no methods other than the accessors
options.says: Limitation 3 says you can add methods to records; only extra instance fields are ruled out.

options.text: They may extend abstract classes but not others
options.says: Limitation 2 says records cannot extend other classes at all, except java.lang.Record.

questions.stem: Which statement about records and class hierarchies matches this page?

options.text: A record may extend another record, but no class may extend a record
options.says: Limitation 2: records cannot extend any class other than java.lang.Record, another record included.

options.text: A record may extend an abstract class, and a class may extend a record
options.says: Limitation 2: records cannot extend other classes, and being implicitly final they cannot be extended.

options.text: A record extends no class of its own choosing, and nothing extends it
options.says: Limitation 2: records cannot extend other classes (except java.lang.Record), and they are implicitly final, so they cannot be extended.
